name: Sea Spray
body:
School conjuration (creation) [water]; Level cleric/oracle 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of water)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A salty mist flies directly into the target’s eyes. They must make a Fortitude save or be blinded by the stinging salt for 1 round.
